preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of weight-1 edges m is non-negative and bounded by the total possible edges and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].
The number of provided edges matches m.

preconditions.expression: len(set(tuple(sorted(e)) for e in edges)) == m
preconditions.description: No edge appears twice in the input (undirected uniqueness).

postconditions.expression: isinstance(output_str, str) and output_str.strip().isdigit() or (output_str.strip() == '-1' and False)
postconditions.description: The output is a single non-negative integer string representing the MST weight.
The output equals the number of connected components formed by 0-weight edges minus 1, which is the minimum number of 1-weight edges required to connect the graph.
